I know this may seem like a bit of a weird post but I have an issue. I was a US player since beta and ever since I started Brick-Force, I have pretty much never lagged and had an almost 0 ping, which was good. But after the US sever was shut down, my ping has not been nearly as good as it was on US. This had bothered me for a long time because I'm not preforming the best I can and lag just sucks tbh. So, I (Mildly) looked into ways that this ping/lag problems could be reduced, and i found this :
"Private companies often have mirrored servers in multiple locations to minimize lag. This can minimize user lag time in some cases" ~idk who.
So this got me thinking, for all the people who don't live close to the EU server, and have spent a good amount of money on this game (me, I beeth ashamed) and have been dedicated to it since the beginning, that they should be able to run the game smoothly regardless of where they live. My idea was to set one up in the US, like before, where the other half of the world could run smoothly, but to mirror the US Server with the EU Server. Essentially what mirroring is, is that it is there are 2 severs essentially connected by a private network, and by doing this, it reduces lag between the parties. Overall its just like the US Server Location and Setup is ADDED ONTO the EU Server. But anyway, it is just something to think about. I personally feel it is unfair to some US players who wanted to continue to play the game, but are limited because of where they live. (Also below is an attached link I skimmed over that could help Infernum if they decided to partake in this)
https://www.comp.nus.edu.sg/~bleong/...3efficient.pdf

That's sounds ridiculous but I truly like it.

We mainly wanted to see if Brick-Force client itself has separated server and channels. As one game with two servers and then splits into multiple channels. Though we somehow had realized that most of all got disconnected at the same time and realized that Veteran-01 is gone. Which it happened few days ago.

But yet I'm still liking this game and so do my sister, but the ping and lag issues is a huge problem for most of the US-Server players out there.

- Kagome0625

title: A proposal regarding "Map of the Month"

posts.h:
I have a proposal that can enhance the build competition: "Map of the Month"

Instead of the developer team taking a vote on which map is better, why don't we host a democracy between the players and let them vote instead?, have them play the entry maps and we'll write an opinion about it.

Anyways, this new method will benefit both the developer and the players themselves.

By doing this, the Developer can actually receive actual attention from the players and gain gratitude from them, in addition to this, they are able to really share out the map and gain force points from this. This will really give a purpose to the map they make instead of just a "submission entry".

This method will also expand the player's viewpoint and taste in maps, this can possibly change the style most player favorably play at: XP maps or very small map such "VIP Lager"
By testing out the maps and giving reviews on it - this can be counted as doing something for the community. Everyone in here is contributing and being part of the community, we might even get new forum members too!

I think this is personally a great way to judge a map, in theory that is.

I also have another community feedback in mind from my set of notes I made. So I'll be posting these prob once per 2 weeks. So stay tuned
posts.t: A proposal regarding "Map of the Month"

posts.h:
Sounds good!

But perhaps letting other members or players like Brick-Agents, Senior Agents, Builders of the Month, Brilliant Builder, and Brainy Builder to vote rather all of the members and players to vote is alright.

With best regards,
Kagome.
why? that's just discriminating - all players should vote

It is not discriminating, it's actually fair to let the Moderators to vote which map are considered the Map of the Month.

Think about it, I mean yes it is alright to allow all players to vote which map can be voted for Map of the Month, but don't you believe that they will perhaps create a map that put less effort to it and maybe "create a advertisement" or forcing most players to vote their map they submitted to be chosen for Map of the Month? To me, yes because that will be extremely unfair to builders who did their hard work and put a much effort to their submitted map and also abusively count as a exploit.

And unlike the FP-Exploit, if all players and members have the rights to vote for which map that is submitted would be chosen for Map of the Month, they will do the same thing that they had did like the FP-Exploits to allow their map to be chosen as Map of the Month easily without a reason.

I am sorry that this may sound discriminating but it's true. So, Moderators and five of the personnel type I suggested should be only allowed to vote.

With best regards,
Kagome.

I agree with both views and disagree (c'mon m8, just make up your mind). I agree with the concept but I think this will be a lot easier said than done. When I first read this forum idea page I really thought this was an amazing idea, and it was something Brick-Force would really benefit from. But the more I got thinking the less I liked it and the more I realized this would not work out how we planned. This would lead to a state of constantly little effort exp farming maps being chosen every month because no body plays anything different (I know you said they would expand their range of maps they play, so I could be miss understanding). This could also lead to corrupt map voters working together and teaming up to vote against certain others. The idea with only people who have some building title or position is good, but is unfair to the rest of the community in general. That is all I really have to say about the topic honestly. Again I like the concept but I just don't think this give the result you'd expect.

There are 3 Types of Sales.
Type 1: Weekend Sale

Type 2: Flash Sales
The Flash Sales normally begin at Tuestay at about 4:00 pm (UTC)

Special Sales are Actions where Items are in the shop that fit to a Special theme (example: Pirate stuff - carnival; Christmas - Cristmas Items)
